title.zh: 卷四十四 列傳第四 謝晦
title.raw: 卷四十四 列傳第四 謝晦 Volume 44 Biographies 4: Xie Hui

sentences.zh: 列傳第四 謝晦

translations.literal: Biographies 4: Xie Hui
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 4: Xie Hui

sentences.zh: 謝晦，字宣明，陳郡陽夏人也。

translations.literal: Xie Hui, styled Xuanming, was a man of Yangxia in Chen commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Hui, whose style was Xuanming, came from Yangxia in Chen commandery.

sentences.zh: 祖朗，東陽太守。

translations.literal: His grandfather Lang was grand administrator of Dongyang.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Lang had served as grand administrator of Dongyang.

sentences.zh: 父重，會稽王道子驃騎長史。

translations.literal: His father Chong was chief clerk to the Cavalry-General-in-Chief for Prince Daozi of Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: His father Chong had been chief clerk on the staff of Prince Daozi of Kuaiji when the latter held the post of Cavalry-General-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 兄絢，高祖鎮軍長史，蚤卒。

translations.literal: His elder brother Xuan was chief clerk to the High Ancestor's campaigning army and died young.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Xuan had served as chief clerk to the High Ancestor's campaigning army and died young.

sentences.zh: 晦初為孟昶建威府中兵參軍。

translations.literal: Hui's first post was as central army adjutant in Meng Chang's Establishing Might headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Hui began his career as central army adjutant on the staff of Meng Chang's Establishing Might headquarters.

sentences.zh: 昶死，高祖問劉穆之：「孟昶參佐，誰堪入我府？」

translations.literal: When Chang died, the High Ancestor asked Liu Muzhi, "Among Meng Chang's staff, who is fit to enter my office?"
translations.idiomatic: After Chang died, the High Ancestor asked Liu Muzhi, "Among Meng Chang's staff, who is fit to join my headquarters?"

sentences.zh: 穆之舉晦，即命為太尉參軍。

translations.literal: Muzhi recommended Hui, and he was at once appointed staff officer to the Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Muzhi recommended Hui, and he was immediately appointed staff officer to the Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 高祖嘗訊囚，其旦刑獄參軍有疾，札晦代之，于車中一鑒訊牒，催促便下。

translations.literal: The High Ancestor once examined prisoners; when the morning criminal-affairs adjutant fell ill, he summoned Hui to replace him. In the carriage Hui glanced once at the interrogation dossier, urged the session on, and had it concluded at once.
translations.idiomatic: The High Ancestor once held a prisoner examination; when the morning adjutant for criminal affairs fell ill, he sent for Hui to take his place. Hui read the interrogation dossier once in the carriage, pressed the proceedings forward, and had the session wrapped up immediately.

sentences.zh: 相府多事，獄繁殷積，晦隨問酬辯，曾無違謬。

translations.literal: The headquarters had many affairs and the dockets piled thick; Hui answered every question on the spot and never once erred.
translations.idiomatic: The headquarters was swamped with business and the criminal dockets piled high, yet Hui fielded every question on the spot without a single mistake.

sentences.zh: 高祖奇之，即日署刑獄賊曹，轉豫州治中從事。

translations.literal: The High Ancestor marveled at him and that very day appointed him to the criminal bureau, then transferred him to assistant director for the administration of Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The High Ancestor was astonished and that same day appointed him to the criminal bureau, then moved him to assistant director for the administration of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 義熙八年，土斷僑流郡縣，使晦分判揚、豫民戶，以平允見稱。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yixi, when refugee districts were consolidated, Hui was assigned to divide households between Yang and Yu provinces and won praise for fairness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Yixi, when the government reallocated refugee populations among the commanderies, Hui was assigned to apportion households between Yang and Yu provinces and won renown for his evenhandedness.

sentences.zh: 入為太尉主簿，從征司馬休之。

translations.literal: He entered service as chief clerk to the Grand Marshal and followed the campaign against Sima Xiuzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He was brought in as chief clerk to the Grand Marshal and accompanied the campaign against Sima Xiuzhi.

sentences.zh: 時徐逵之戰敗見殺，高祖怒，將自被甲登岸，諸將諫，不從，怒愈甚。

translations.literal: At the time Xu Daizhi had been defeated and killed; the High Ancestor in his rage was about to don armor and go ashore himself. The generals remonstrated but he would not listen, and his anger only grew.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Daizhi had just been defeated and killed; the High Ancestor, furious, was about to don armor and go ashore in person. The generals pleaded with him but he would not listen, and his rage only mounted.

sentences.zh: 晦前抱持高祖，高祖曰：「我斬卿！」

translations.literal: Hui rushed forward and held the High Ancestor fast. The High Ancestor said, "I will cut you down!"
translations.idiomatic: Hui rushed forward and seized hold of the High Ancestor. The High Ancestor cried, "I'll cut you down!"

sentences.zh: 晦曰：「天下可無晦，不可無公，晦死何有！」

translations.literal: Hui said, "The empire can do without Hui but not without Your Lordship—what would it matter if Hui died!"
translations.idiomatic: Hui replied, "The realm can spare Hui, but it cannot spare Your Lordship—what would it matter if Hui died!"

sentences.zh: 會胡蕃已得登岸，賊退走，乃止。

translations.literal: Just then Hu Fan had already gained the shore and the enemy fled; only then did he stop.
translations.idiomatic: By then Hu Fan had already made it ashore and the enemy had fled, and only then did he desist.

sentences.zh: 晦美風姿，善言笑，眉目分明，鬢髮如點漆。

translations.literal: Hui was handsome in bearing and graceful in speech and laughter; his brows and eyes were distinct, and his temples and hair black as lacquer.
translations.idiomatic: Hui was striking in appearance and gifted at conversation and wit; his features were sharply defined, and his temples and hair were black as lacquer.

sentences.zh: 涉獵文義，朗贍多通，高祖深加愛賞，群僚莫及。

translations.literal: He had dipped into literary learning and was brilliant and widely learned; the High Ancestor treasured and admired him deeply, and none of his colleagues could match him.
translations.idiomatic: He had ranged through literary studies and was brilliant and widely versed; the High Ancestor cherished and admired him beyond measure, and none of his colleagues could compare.

sentences.zh: 從征關、洛，內外要任悉委之。

translations.literal: On the campaigns against Guanzhong and Luoyang, every inner and outer post of importance was entrusted to him.
translations.idiomatic: On the campaigns against Guanzhong and Luoyang, every key post at court and in the field was placed in his hands.

sentences.zh: 劉穆之遣使陳事，晦往往措異同，穆之怒曰：「公復有還時否？」

translations.literal: When Liu Muzhi sent messengers to report business, Hui often took a different view. Muzhi in anger said, "Will the lord ever come back?"
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Liu Muzhi sent messengers with official business, Hui often disagreed. Muzhi said in anger, "Will the lord ever return?"

sentences.zh: 高祖欲以為從事中郎，以訪穆之，堅執不與。

translations.literal: The High Ancestor wished to make him attendant gentleman and consulted Muzhi, who adamantly refused.
translations.idiomatic: The High Ancestor wished to appoint him attendant gentleman and consulted Muzhi, who adamantly refused.

sentences.zh: 終穆之世，不遷。

translations.literal: Throughout Muzhi's lifetime he was not promoted.
translations.idiomatic: For as long as Muzhi lived, he received no further promotion.

sentences.zh: 穆之喪問至，高祖哭之甚慟。

translations.literal: When news of Muzhi's death arrived, the High Ancestor wept with great grief.
translations.idiomatic: When word of Muzhi's death arrived, the High Ancestor wept bitterly.

sentences.zh: 晦時正直，喜甚，自入閣內參審穆之死問。

translations.literal: Hui was then on upright duty and was greatly pleased; he went into the inner quarters himself to verify the report of Muzhi's death.
translations.idiomatic: Hui was then on upright duty and was overjoyed; he went into the inner quarters himself to confirm the report of Muzhi's death.

sentences.zh: 其日教出，轉晦從事中郎。

translations.literal: That day an order went out promoting Hui to attendant gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: That same day an order was issued promoting Hui to attendant gentleman.

sentences.zh: 宋臺初建，為右衛將軍，尋加侍中。

translations.literal: When the Song regime was first established, he became general of the right guards and soon added gentleman attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song regime was first established, he was made general of the right guards and soon afterward was also appointed gentleman attendant.

sentences.zh: 高祖受命，於石頭登壇，備法駕入宮。

translations.literal: When the High Ancestor received the Mandate, he ascended the altar at Shitou with full imperial equipage and entered the palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the High Ancestor received the Mandate, he ascended the altar at Shitou with full imperial regalia and entered the palace.

sentences.zh: 晦領游軍為警備，遷中領軍，侍中如故。

translations.literal: Hui commanded the mobile guard as escort and was moved to general of the central army, remaining gentleman attendant as before.
translations.idiomatic: Hui led the mobile guard as escort, then was transferred to general of the central army while retaining his post as gentleman attendant.

sentences.zh: 以佐命功，封武昌縣公，食邑二千戶。

translations.literal: For his merit in establishing the dynasty he was enfeoffed as duke of Wuchang county with a fief of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit in helping establish the dynasty, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Wuchang with a fief of two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 二年，坐行璽封鎮西司馬、南郡太守王華大封，而誤封北海太守球，版免晦侍中。

translations.literal: In the second year he was punished for carrying the seal to appoint Wang Hua, defender-general of the west and grand administrator of Nan commandery, with a great seal, but mistakenly sealing the appointment of Qiu as grand administrator of Beihai; Hui was removed from gentleman attendant by written order.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was punished because, while carrying the imperial seal to appoint Wang Hua—defender-general of the west and grand administrator of Nan commandery—with a grand commission, he had mistakenly sealed the appointment of Qiu as grand administrator of Beihai instead; by written order Hui was stripped of his post as gentleman attendant.

sentences.zh: 尋轉領軍將軍、散騎常侍，依晉中軍羊祜故事，入直殿省，總統宿衛。

translations.literal: Soon he was made general of the inspecting army and regular attendant, following the Jin precedent of Zhongjun Yang Hu in entering duty at the hall precinct to command the night guard.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made general of the inspecting army and regular attendant; following the Jin precedent of Zhongjun Yang Hu, he entered duty at the hall precinct and took overall command of the night guard.

sentences.zh: 三月，高祖不豫，給班劍二十人，與徐羨之、傅亮、檀道濟並侍醫藥。

translations.literal: In the third month, when the High Ancestor fell ill, he was given twenty court swords and, together with Xu Xianzhi, Fu Liang, and Tan Daoji, attended to his medicine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, when the High Ancestor fell ill, he was granted twenty court swords and, together with Xu Xianzhi, Fu Liang, and Tan Daoji, attended to his medical care.

sentences.zh: 少帝即位，加領中書令，與羨之，亮共輔朝政。

translations.literal: When the Young Emperor acceded, Hui was additionally made director of the Secretariat and, with Xianzhi and Liang, shared governance of the court.
translations.idiomatic: When the Young Emperor acceded, Hui was additionally made director of the Secretariat and, together with Xianzhi and Liang, helped govern the court.

sentences.zh: 少帝既廢，司空徐羨之錄詔命，以晦行都督荊、湘、雍、益、寧、南、北秦七州諸軍事、撫軍將軍、領護南蠻校尉、荊州刺史，欲令居外為援，慮太祖至或別用人，故遽有此授。

translations.literal: After the Young Emperor was deposed, Minister Xu Xianzhi recorded the edict appointing Hui acting commander of military affairs in seven provinces, general of the pacifying army, colonel protecting the southern barbarians, and inspector of Jing province, wishing to keep him outside as support and fearing that when the Founding Emperor arrived he might appoint someone else—hence this hurried grant.
translations.idiomatic: After the Young Emperor was deposed, Minister Xu Xianzhi drafted the edict appointing Hui acting commander of military affairs across seven provinces, general of the pacifying army, colonel protecting the southern barbarians, and inspector of Jing province. They wanted him stationed outside the capital as a reserve force, fearing that when the Founding Emperor arrived he might place someone else in the post—hence this hurried appointment.

sentences.zh: 精兵舊將，悉以配之，器仗軍資甚盛。

translations.literal: Elite troops and veteran generals were all assigned to him, and his weapons and military stores were exceedingly ample.
translations.idiomatic: Elite troops and veteran commanders were all assigned to him, and his arms and military stores were lavishly supplied.

sentences.zh: 太祖即位，加使持節，依本位除授。

translations.literal: When the Founding Emperor acceded, Hui was additionally made commissioner with staff and confirmed in his original appointments.
translations.idiomatic: When the Founding Emperor acceded, Hui was additionally made commissioner with staff and confirmed in his existing posts.

sentences.zh: 晦慮不得去，甚憂惶，及發新亭，顧望石頭城，喜曰：「今得脫矣。」

translations.literal: Hui feared he would not be allowed to leave and was deeply anxious; when he set out from Xinting and looked back at Shitou fortress, he said with joy, "Now I have escaped."
translations.idiomatic: Hui feared he would not be permitted to leave and was deeply troubled; when he departed from Xinting and looked back toward Shitou fortress, he said with relief, "Now I have gotten away."

sentences.zh: 尋進號衛將軍，加散騎常侍，進封建平郡公，食邑四千戶，固讓進封。

translations.literal: Soon his title was advanced to defender general, he was made regular attendant, and promoted to Duke of Jianping commandery with a fief of four thousand households; he repeatedly declined the advancement in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his title was advanced to defender general, he was made regular attendant, and promoted to Duke of Jianping with a fief of four thousand households, though he repeatedly declined the advancement in rank.

sentences.zh: 又給鼓吹一部。

translations.literal: He was also given one set of military music.
translations.idiomatic: He was also granted a full set of military music.

sentences.zh: 初為荊州，甚有自矜之色，將之鎮，詣從叔光祿大夫澹別。

translations.literal: When he first took Jing province he was very self-satisfied; as he was about to go to his post, he called on his father's younger cousin, Household Master of the Heir Apparent Dan, to take leave.
translations.idiomatic: When he first received Jing province he was full of self-importance; as he was about to depart for his post, he called on his father's younger cousin, Household Master of the Heir Apparent Dan, to bid farewell.

sentences.zh: 澹問晦年，晦答曰：「三十五。」

translations.literal: Dan asked Hui his age, and Hui answered, "Thirty-five."
translations.idiomatic: Dan asked Hui his age, and Hui replied, "Thirty-five."

sentences.zh: 澹笑曰：「昔荀中郎年二十七為北府都督，卿比之，已為老矣。」

translations.literal: Dan smiled and said, "In former days Director Xun at twenty-seven was commander of the Northern Headquarters; compared with him, you are already old."
translations.idiomatic: Dan smiled and said, "In former days Director Xun at twenty-seven was commander of the Northern Headquarters; compared with him, you are already an old man."

sentences.zh: 晦有愧色。

translations.literal: Hui looked ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: Hui flushed with embarrassment.

sentences.zh: 至江陵，深結侍中王華，冀以免禍。

translations.literal: When he reached Jiangling he formed a deep bond with gentleman attendant Wang Hua, hoping thereby to escape disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching Jiangling he cultivated a close tie with gentleman attendant Wang Hua, hoping thereby to escape ruin.

sentences.zh: 二女當配彭城王義康、新野侯義賓。

translations.literal: His two daughters were to be married to Prince Yikang of Pengcheng and Marquis Yibin of Xinye.
translations.idiomatic: His two daughters were to be married to Prince Yikang of Pengcheng and Marquis Yibin of Xinye.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二年，遣妻曹及長子世休送女還京邑。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanjia he sent his wife Cao and his eldest son Shixiu to escort the daughters back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanjia he sent his wife Cao and his eldest son Shixiu to escort the daughters back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 先是景平中，索虜為寇，覆沒河南。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the Jingping era, the northern barbarians raided and overran Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, during the Jingping era, the northern barbarians had raided and overrun Henan.

sentences.zh: 至是上欲誅羨之等，並討晦。

translations.literal: By this time the emperor wished to execute Xianzhi and the others and also move against Hui.
translations.idiomatic: By then the emperor intended to execute Xianzhi and his colleagues and also move against Hui.

sentences.zh: 聲言北伐，又言拜京陵，治裝舟艦。

translations.literal: He proclaimed a northern campaign and also spoke of visiting the imperial tombs at the capital, fitting out ships and equipment.
translations.idiomatic: He announced a northern campaign and also spoke of visiting the imperial tombs near the capital, ordering ships and equipment prepared.

sentences.zh: 傅亮與晦書曰：「薄伐河朔，事猶未已，朝野之慮，憂懼者多。」

translations.literal: Fu Liang wrote to Hui, "The shallow campaign against the north bank of the Yellow River is still unfinished; throughout court and country many are anxious and afraid."
translations.idiomatic: Fu Liang wrote to Hui, "The limited campaign against the north bank of the Yellow River is still unfinished, and throughout court and country anxiety runs high."

sentences.zh: 又言：「朝士多諫北征，上當遣外監萬幼宗往相咨訪。」

translations.literal: He also said, "Many at court have remonstrated against the northern expedition; the emperor is likely to send the external supervisor Wan Youzong to consult with you."
translations.idiomatic: He added, "Many at court have urged against the northern expedition; the emperor is likely to send the external supervisor Wan Youzong to consult with you."

sentences.zh: 時朝廷處分異常，其謀頗泄。

translations.literal: At the time the court's measures were unusual, and the plan leaked out considerably.
translations.idiomatic: The court's movements were already highly irregular, and the plan leaked out widely.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，晦弟黃門侍郎皭馳使告晦，晦猶謂不然，呼諮議參軍何承天，示以亮書，曰：「計幼宗一二日必至，傅公慮我好事，故先遣此書。」

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, Hui's younger brother, Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Hui, sent a fast messenger to inform Hui. Hui still thought it untrue, summoned advisory staff officer He Chengtian, showed him Liang's letter, and said, "I reckon Youzong will arrive in a day or two; Master Fu feared I would take alarm, so he sent this letter first."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, Hui's younger brother, Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Hui, sent a fast courier to warn him. Hui still refused to believe it, summoned advisory staff officer He Chengtian, showed him Liang's letter, and said, "I expect Youzong will arrive in a day or two; Master Fu feared I would take alarm, so he sent this letter ahead."

sentences.zh: 承天曰：「外間所聞，咸謂西討已定，幼宗豈有上理。」

translations.literal: Chengtian said, "What is heard outside is that the western punitive campaign is already settled; how could Youzong be coming?"
translations.idiomatic: Chengtian said, "What people are saying outside is that the western punitive campaign is already decided; there is no reason Youzong should be coming."

sentences.zh: 晦尚謂虛妄，使承天豫立答詔啟草，伐虜宜須明年。

translations.literal: Hui still considered it false and had Chengtian prepare in advance a draft memorial replying to the edict, saying the campaign against the barbarians should wait until next year.
translations.idiomatic: Hui still treated it as empty rumor and had Chengtian prepare in advance a draft memorial replying to the edict, arguing that the campaign against the barbarians should wait until the following year.

sentences.zh: 江夏內史程道惠得尋陽人書，言：「朝廷將有大處分，其事已審。」

translations.literal: Jiangxia's interior administrator Cheng Daohui received a letter from a man of Xunyang saying, "The court is about to take drastic measures; the matter is already settled."
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Daohui, interior administrator of Jiangxia, received a letter from a man of Xunyang stating, "The court is about to take drastic action; the matter is already decided."

sentences.zh: 使其輔國府中兵參軍樂冏封以示晦。

translations.literal: He had his assisting-state headquarters central army adjutant Yue Tong seal it and show it to Hui.
translations.idiomatic: He had his assisting-state headquarters central army adjutant Yue Tong seal the letter and deliver it to Hui.

sentences.zh: 晦又謂承天曰：「幼宗尚未至，若復二三日無消息，便是不復來邪？」

translations.literal: Hui again said to Chengtian, "Youzong has not yet arrived; if in another two or three days there is no word, does that mean he is not coming after all?"
translations.idiomatic: Hui said again to Chengtian, "Youzong has not yet arrived; if there is still no word in another two or three days, does that mean he is not coming at all?"

sentences.zh: 承天答曰：「詔使本無來理，如程所說，其事已判，豈容復疑。」

translations.literal: Chengtian answered, "There was never any reason for an imperial messenger to come; as Cheng said, the matter is already decided—how could there still be doubt?".
translations.idiomatic: Chengtian replied, "There was never any reason for an imperial messenger to come; as Cheng reported, the matter is already settled—how could there still be any doubt?".

sentences.zh: 晦欲焚南蠻兵籍，率見力決戰。

translations.literal: Hui wished to burn the southern barbarian troop registers and lead his present forces to fight to the decision.
translations.idiomatic: Hui wished to burn the southern barbarian troop registers and lead his available forces into a decisive battle.

sentences.zh: 士人多勸發兵，乃立幡戒嚴，謂司馬庾登之曰：「今當自下，欲屈卿以三千人守城，備禦劉粹。」

translations.literal: Many of his officers urged raising troops; he then raised banners and declared martial law, and said to his defender Sima Yu Dengzhi, "I am about to go downstream and wish to ask you to hold the city with three thousand men against Liu Cui."
translations.idiomatic: Many of his officers urged him to raise troops; he then raised banners and declared martial law and said to his defender Sima Yu Dengzhi, "I am about to march downstream and would ask you to hold the city with three thousand men against Liu Cui."

sentences.zh: 登之曰：「下官親老在都，又素無旅，情計二三，不敢受此旨。」

translations.literal: Dengzhi said, "My parents are old and in the capital, and I have never been on campaign; my mind wavers in two or three ways—I dare not accept this commission."
translations.idiomatic: Dengzhi said, "My parents are elderly and live in the capital, and I have never been on campaign; my resolve is divided—I dare not accept this commission."

sentences.zh: 晦仍問諸佐：「戰士三千，足守城不？」

translations.literal: Hui then asked his staff, "Are three thousand fighting men enough to hold the city?"
translations.idiomatic: Hui then asked his staff, "Are three thousand fighting men enough to hold the city?"

sentences.zh: 南蠻司馬周超對曰：「非徒守城而已，若有外寇，可以立勳。」

translations.literal: Southern barbarian defender Sima Zhou Chao replied, "It is not merely a matter of holding the city; if there is an outside enemy, one can win merit."
translations.idiomatic: Southern barbarian defender Sima Zhou Chao replied, "It is not merely a matter of holding the city—if outside enemies appear, one can win distinction."

sentences.zh: 登之乃曰：「超必能辦，下官請解司馬、南郡以授。」

translations.literal: Dengzhi then said, "Chao can certainly manage it; I ask to be relieved of defender and Nan commandery and have them given to him."
translations.idiomatic: Dengzhi then said, "Chao can certainly handle it; I ask to be relieved of my posts as defender and administrator of Nan commandery and have them transferred to him."

sentences.zh: 即於坐命超為司馬、建威將軍、南義陽太守，轉登之為長史，南郡如故。

translations.literal: On the spot he appointed Chao defender, general establishing might, and grand administrator of Nan Yiyang, and transferred Dengzhi to chief clerk while retaining Nan commandery as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the spot he appointed Chao defender, general establishing might, and grand administrator of Nan Yiyang, and transferred Dengzhi to chief clerk while leaving Nan commandery under his charge as before.

sentences.zh: 太祖誅羨之等及晦子新除秘書郎世休，收皭、皭子世平、兄子著作佐郎紹等。

translations.literal: The Founding Emperor executed Xianzhi and the others and Hui's son, the newly appointed secretary Shixiu; he arrested Hui, Hui's son Shiping, and his elder brother's son, editorial assistant Shao, and others.
translations.idiomatic: The Founding Emperor executed Xianzhi and his colleagues, along with Hui's son Shixiu, who had just been appointed secretary; he also arrested Hui, Hui's son Shiping, and his elder brother's son, editorial assistant Shao, among others.

sentences.zh: 樂冏又遣使告晦：「徐、傅二公及皭等並已誅。」

translations.literal: Yue Tong again sent a messenger to inform Hui, "The two lords Xu and Fu and Hui and the rest have all been executed."
translations.idiomatic: Yue Tong again sent a messenger to inform Hui, "Lords Xu and Fu, along with Hui and the others, have all been executed."

sentences.zh: 晦先舉羨之、亮哀，次發子弟凶問。

translations.literal: Hui first raised mourning for Xianzhi and Liang, then announced the dire news about his sons and nephews.
translations.idiomatic: Hui first proclaimed mourning for Xianzhi and Liang, then announced the dire news about his sons and nephews.

sentences.zh: 既而自出射堂，配衣軍旅。

translations.literal: Then he himself came out to the archery ground and arrayed himself in military dress.
translations.idiomatic: Then he himself came out to the archery ground and arrayed himself in military dress.

sentences.zh: 數從高祖征討，備睹經略，至是指麾處分，莫不曲盡其宜。

translations.literal: He had followed the High Ancestor on many campaigns and witnessed his strategy in full; now in command and disposition nothing failed to suit the occasion perfectly.
translations.idiomatic: He had followed the High Ancestor on many campaigns and witnessed his strategy at first hand; now, in command and disposition, nothing failed to suit the occasion perfectly.

sentences.zh: 二三日中，四遠投集，得精兵三萬人。

translations.literal: Within two or three days men gathered from all directions, and he obtained elite troops numbering thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Within two or three days men rallied from all directions, and he mustered thirty thousand elite troops.

sentences.zh: 乃奉表曰：

translations.literal: He then submitted a memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: He then submitted a memorial that read:

sentences.zh: 臣階緣幸會，蒙武皇帝殊常之眷，外聞政事，內謀帷幄，經綸夷險，毗贊王業，預佐命之勳，膺河山之賞。

translations.literal: Your servant, by steps of fortunate chance, received the Martial Emperor's extraordinary favor, hearing affairs outside and plotting within the command tent, threading through peril and ease and supporting the royal enterprise, sharing in the merit of establishing the dynasty and receiving rewards like mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant, through a chain of fortunate chances, won the Martial Emperor's extraordinary favor—hearing affairs abroad and plotting within the command tent, steering through peril and ease and supporting the royal enterprise, sharing in the merit of establishing the dynasty and receiving rewards vast as mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 及先帝不豫，導揚末命，臣與故司徒臣羨之、左光祿大夫臣亮、征北將軍臣道濟等，並升御床，跪受遺詔，載貽話言，訊以後事。

translations.literal: When the late emperor fell ill, he guided and proclaimed his final charge; your servant, together with the late Minister Xianzhi, Left Household Master Liang, and Northern Campaigning General Daoji and others, all ascended the imperial couch, knelt to receive the testament, bore his parting words, and were questioned on affairs to come.
translations.idiomatic: When the late emperor fell ill, he guided and proclaimed his final charge; your servant, together with the late Minister Xianzhi, Left Household Master Liang, and Northern Campaigning General Daoji and others, all ascended the imperial couch, knelt to receive the testament, bore his parting words, and were questioned about affairs to come.

sentences.zh: 臣雖凡淺，感恩自厲，送往事居，誠貫幽顯。

translations.literal: Though your servant is shallow and ordinary, in gratitude he urges himself on; serving the dead and living the living, his sincerity pierces the hidden and the manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Though your servant is shallow and ordinary, in gratitude he urges himself onward; honoring the dead and serving the living, his sincerity reaches from this world into the next.

sentences.zh: 逮營陽失德，自絕宗廟，朝野岌岌，憂及禍難，忠謀協契，徇國忘己，援登聖朝，惟新皇祚。

translations.literal: When Yingyang lost virtue and cut himself off from the ancestral temple, court and country were in peril and disaster loomed; loyal counsel joined in pact, forgetting self for the state, and helped raise the sacred court and renew the imperial fortune.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingyang lost virtue and cut himself off from the ancestral temple, court and country stood in peril and disaster loomed; loyal counsel joined in pact, forgetting self for the state, and helped raise the sacred court to renew the imperial fortune.

sentences.zh: 陛下馳傳乘流，曾不惟疑，臨朝殷勤，增崇封爵。

translations.literal: Your Majesty rode post-haste upon the current without a moment's doubt; upon taking the throne you were earnest and increased our ranks and fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty rode post-haste upon the current without a moment's hesitation; upon taking the throne you were earnest and increased our ranks and fiefs.

sentences.zh: 此則臣等赤心已亮於天鑒，遠近萬邦咸達於聖旨。

translations.literal: Thus our loyal hearts were already clear to Heaven's mirror, and near and far, all the myriad realms understood the imperial intent.
translations.idiomatic: Thus our loyal hearts were already plain to Heaven's scrutiny, and near and far, all the myriad realms understood the imperial intent.

sentences.zh: 若臣等志欲專權，不顧國典，便當協翼幼主，孤背天日，豈復虛館七旬，仰望鸞旗者哉？

translations.literal: If we had wished to monopolize power and disregard the state's laws, we would have aided the young lord and turned our backs on Heaven and the sun—how could we then have kept him in an empty lodge for seventy days, gazing up at the imperial banner?
translations.idiomatic: If we had wished to monopolize power and disregard the state's laws, we would have aided the young lord and turned our backs on Heaven and the sun—how could we then have kept him in an empty lodge for seventy days, gazing up at the imperial banner?

sentences.zh: 故廬陵王於營陽之世，屢被猜嫌，積怨犯上，自貽非命。

translations.literal: Thus the Prince of Luling, in Yingyang's time, was repeatedly suspected, harbored resentment and offended his superiors, and brought ruin upon himself.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Prince of Luling, during Yingyang's reign, was repeatedly suspected, harbored resentment and offended his superiors, and brought ruin upon himself.

sentences.zh: 天祚明德，屬當昌運，不有所廢，將何以興？

translations.literal: Heaven's mandate is bright in virtue and belongs to a flourishing age; without setting something aside, how could it rise?
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's mandate is bright in virtue and belongs to a flourishing age; without setting something aside, how could the dynasty rise?

sentences.zh: 成人之美，《春秋》之高義；

translations.literal: Completing another's excellence is the lofty meaning of the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》;
translations.idiomatic: Completing another's excellence is the lofty principle of the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》;

sentences.zh: 立帝清館，臣節之所司。

translations.literal: establishing an emperor in a pure lodge is what a subject's duty oversees.
translations.idiomatic: establishing an emperor in a pure lodge is what a subject's duty demands.

sentences.zh: 耿弇不以賊遺君父，臣亦何負於宋室邪？

translations.literal: Geng Yan did not leave the bandits to his lord and father—how has your servant wronged the house of Song?
translations.idiomatic: Geng Yan did not leave the rebels to his lord and father—how has your servant wronged the house of Song?

sentences.zh: 況釁結鬩牆，禍成畏逼，天下耳目，豈伊可誣！

translations.literal: Moreover, trouble arose within the walls, disaster came from coercion and fear—the ears and eyes of the empire, how could they be deceived!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, trouble arose within the palace walls, and disaster came from coercion and fear—the ears and eyes of the empire, how could they be deceived!

sentences.zh: 臣忝居蕃任，乃誠匪懈，為政小大，必先啟聞。

translations.literal: Your servant, unworthy in a frontier post, has not slackened in sincerity; in government great and small he has always reported first.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant, unworthy though entrusted with a frontier post, has not slackened in sincerity; in government great and small he has always reported first.

sentences.zh: 糾剔群蠻，清夷境內，分留弟姪，並侍殿省。

translations.literal: He has disciplined the southern tribes and cleared the territory within his borders, leaving younger brothers and nephews behind, all serving in the palace offices.
translations.idiomatic: He has disciplined the southern tribes and pacified the territory within his borders, leaving younger brothers and nephews behind, all serving in the palace offices.

sentences.zh: 陛下聿遵先志，申以婚姻，童稚之目，猥荷齒召，薦女遷子，合門相送。

translations.literal: Your Majesty has followed the former intent and extended marriage ties; even a child's eyes have undeservedly received your summons by rank; presenting daughters and sending sons, the whole household has seen them off.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has followed the former intent and extended marriage ties; even a child's eyes have undeservedly received your summons by rank; presenting daughters and sending sons, the whole household has seen them off.

sentences.zh: 事君之道，義盡於斯。

translations.literal: The way of serving one's lord—duty has been fulfilled to the utmost here.
translations.idiomatic: In the way of serving one's lord, duty has been fulfilled to the utmost.

sentences.zh: 臣羨之總錄百揆，翼亮三世，年耆乞退，屢抗表疏，優旨綢繆，未垂順許。

translations.literal: Your servant Xianzhi has overseen all the ministries and supported three reigns; in his old age he has asked to retire and repeatedly submitted memorials, yet gracious edicts have been thick and no favorable permission granted.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant Xianzhi has overseen all the ministries and supported three reigns; in his old age he has asked to retire and repeatedly submitted memorials, yet gracious edicts have been thick and no favorable permission granted.

sentences.zh: 臣亮管司喉舌，恪虔夙夜，恭謹一心，守死善道。

translations.literal: Your servant Liang has managed the imperial voice, been reverent night and day, single-minded in respect, and held to the good way unto death.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant Liang has managed the imperial voice, been reverent night and day, single-minded in respect, and held to the good way unto death.

sentences.zh: 此皆皇宋之宗臣，社稷之鎮衛，而讒人傾覆，妄生國釁，天威震怒，加以極刑，并及臣門，則被孥戮。

translations.literal: These were all pillar ministers of the imperial Song and bulwarks of the altars of soil and grain, yet slanderers overturned them and rashly stirred national strife; imperial wrath thundered, extreme punishments were added, and our households too were struck with execution extending to wives and children.
translations.idiomatic: These were all pillar ministers of the imperial Song and bulwarks of the altars of soil and grain, yet slanderers overturned them and rashly stirred national strife; imperial wrath thundered, extreme punishments were imposed, and our households too were struck down, wives and children included.

sentences.zh: 雖未知臣道濟問，推理即事，不容獨存。

translations.literal: Though it is not yet known what has befallen your servant Daoji, reasoning from the matter, he cannot be left alone.
translations.idiomatic: Though it is not yet known what has befallen your servant Daoji, reasoning from the matter, he cannot be left alone.

sentences.zh: 先帝顧託元臣翼命之佐，勦於佞邪之手，忠貞匪躬之輔，不免夷滅之誅。

translations.literal: The late emperor's entrusted chief ministers and aides who bore his mandate have been cut down by the hands of flatterers and villains; loyal and devoted helpers who gave their all have not escaped extermination.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor's entrusted chief ministers and aides who bore his mandate have been cut down by flatterers and villains; loyal and devoted helpers who gave their all have not escaped extermination.

sentences.zh: 陛下春秋方富，始覽萬機，民之情偽，未能鑒悉。

translations.literal: Your Majesty's years are still rich and you have only begun to survey the myriad affairs of state; the people's truth and falsehood you cannot yet discern fully.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is still young and has only begun to survey the myriad affairs of state; the people's truth and falsehood you cannot yet discern fully.

sentences.zh: 王弘兄弟，輕躁昧進；

translations.literal: The brothers Wang Hong are rash and advance in ignorance;
translations.idiomatic: The brothers Wang Hong are rash and advance in ignorance;

sentences.zh: 王華猜忌忍害，規弄威權，先除執政，以逞其欲。

translations.literal: Wang Hua is suspicious, cruel, and harmful, scheming to wield authority, first removing those in power to satisfy his desires.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hua is suspicious, cruel, and harmful, scheming to wield authority, first removing those in power to satisfy his desires.

sentences.zh: 天下之人，知與不知，孰不為之痛心憤怨者哉！

translations.literal: Among all under Heaven, whether they know the details or not, who does not grieve and rage at this!
translations.idiomatic: Among all under Heaven, whether they know the details or not, who does not grieve and rage at this!

sentences.zh: 臣等見任先帝，垂二十載，小心謹慎，無纖介之愆，伏事甫爾，而嬰若斯之罪。

translations.literal: We have served the late emperor for nearly twenty years, careful and cautious, without the slightest fault; we had just begun to serve Your Majesty when we suffered such punishment.
translations.idiomatic: We served the late emperor for nearly twenty years, careful and cautious, without the slightest fault; we had only just begun to serve Your Majesty when we suffered such punishment.

sentences.zh: 若非先帝謬於知人，則為陛下未察愚款。

translations.literal: If it was not that the late emperor erred in knowing men, then Your Majesty has not yet discerned our sincere devotion.
translations.idiomatic: If the late emperor did not err in knowing men, then Your Majesty has not yet discerned our sincere devotion.

sentences.zh: 臣去歲末使反，得朝士及殿省諸將書，並言嫌隙已成，必有今日之事。

translations.literal: Your servant's envoy returned at the end of last year and obtained letters from court officials and generals of the palace offices, all saying that estrangement had already formed and that today's events were inevitable.
translations.idiomatic: When your servant's envoy returned at the end of last year, he obtained letters from court officials and generals of the palace offices, all saying that estrangement had already formed and that today's events were inevitable.

sentences.zh: 臣推誠仰期，罔有二心，不圖奸回潛遘，理順難恃，忠賢隕朝，愚臣見襲，到彥之、蕭欣等在近路。

translations.literal: Your servant looked up in sincerity and expected no second thought, never imagining that treachery would lurk in secret; when reason favors one, support is hard to rely on—loyal worthies fall in court, your foolish servant is attacked, and Dao Yanzhi and Xiao Xin are on the near road.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant looked up in sincerity and harbored no second thought, never imagining that treachery would lurk in secret; when reason favors one, support is hard to rely on—loyal worthies fall in court, your foolish servant is attacked, and Dao Yanzhi and Xiao Xin are on the near road.

sentences.zh: 昔白公稱亂，諸梁嬰胄，惡人在朝，趙鞅入伐。

translations.literal: In former days when Duke Bai raised rebellion, the sons of Liang donned armor; when evil men are in court, Zhao Yang enters to punish them.
translations.idiomatic: In former days when Duke Bai raised rebellion, the sons of Liang donned armor; when evil men hold court, Zhao Yang enters to punish them.

sentences.zh: 臣義均休戚，任居分陝，豈可顛而不扶，以負先帝遺旨！

translations.literal: Your servant shares equally in weal and woe and holds office in the partition of Shaan—how can one see it overturned and not support it, to fail the late emperor's final charge!
translations.idiomatic: Your servant shares equally in weal and woe and holds border governance—how can I stand by while the realm collapses and fail the late emperor's final charge!

sentences.zh: 輒率將士，繕治舟甲，須其自送，投袂撲討。

translations.literal: I shall immediately lead officers and soldiers, repair ships and armor, await them to deliver themselves, shake my sleeves and strike to suppress.
translations.idiomatic: I shall immediately lead my officers and soldiers, ready ships and armor, await their coming, and strike out to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 若天祚大宋，卜世靈長，義師克振，中流清蕩，便當浮舟東下，戮此三豎，申理冤恥，謝罪闕庭，雖伏鑕赴鑊，無恨於心。

translations.literal: If Heaven blesses Great Song and the dynasty's destiny is long, and the righteous army prevails and clears the middle reaches, then I shall float boats eastward, execute these three villains, vindicate our wrongs and shame, confess guilt at the palace gate—even though I submit to axe and cauldron, I will have no regret in my heart.
translations.idiomatic: If Heaven blesses Great Song and the dynasty's destiny is long, and the righteous army prevails and clears the middle reaches, then I shall sail eastward, execute these three villains, vindicate our wrongs, and confess guilt at the palace gate—even if I must submit to axe and cauldron, I will have no regret in my heart.

sentences.zh: 伏願陛下遠尋永初託付之旨，近存元嘉奉戴之誠，則微臣丹款，猶有可察。

translations.literal: I humbly hope Your Majesty will look far back to the entrustment charge of the Yongchu era and keep close the sincerity of support in the Yuanjia era—then this humble servant's loyal heart may still be discerned.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly hope Your Majesty will look far back to the entrustment charge of the Yongchu era and keep close the sincerity of support in the Yuanjia era—then this humble servant's loyal heart may still be discerned.

sentences.zh: 臨表哽慨，言不自盡。

translations.literal: Facing the memorial, choked with emotion, my words cannot fully express themselves.
translations.idiomatic: As I face this memorial, I am choked with emotion and cannot fully express myself.

sentences.zh: 太祖時已戒嚴，諸軍相次進路。

translations.literal: By this time the Founding Emperor had already imposed martial law, and the armies successively advanced on the roads.
translations.idiomatic: By this time the Founding Emperor had already imposed martial law, and the armies advanced one after another.

sentences.zh: 尚書符荊州曰：

translations.literal: The Secretariat dispatched an order to Jing Province stating:
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat dispatched an order to Jing Province stating:

sentences.zh: 禍福無門，逆順有數，天道微於影響，人事鑒於前圖，未有蹈義而福不延，從惡而禍不至也。

translations.literal: Fortune and misfortune have no fixed gate; rebellion and obedience have their measure. The Way of Heaven is subtle as shadow and echo; human affairs are mirrored in former charts—never has one who treads righteousness failed to receive extended fortune, nor has one who follows evil escaped calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Fortune and misfortune have no fixed gate; rebellion and obedience have their measure. The Way of Heaven is subtle as shadow and echo; human affairs are mirrored in past examples—never has one who treads righteousness failed to receive lasting fortune, nor has one who follows evil escaped calamity.

sentences.zh: 故智計之士，審敗以立功，守正之臣，臨難以全節。

translations.literal: Thus men of wisdom and strategy discern defeat to establish merit; upright ministers, facing difficulty, preserve their integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Thus men of wisdom and strategy discern defeat and establish merit; upright ministers, facing difficulty, preserve their integrity.

sentences.zh: 徐羨之、傅亮、謝晦，安忍鴆殺，獲罪於天，名教所極，政刑所取，已遠暴四海，宣於聖詔。

translations.literal: Xu Xianzhi, Fu Liang, and Xie Hui cruelly conspired to poison and kill; they have offended Heaven, reached the limit of morality and teaching, and are taken by law and punishment—their crimes have been proclaimed to the four seas and announced in the imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Xianzhi, Fu Liang, and Xie Hui cruelly conspired to poison and kill; they have offended Heaven, transgressed the limits of morality and teaching, and are subject to law and punishment—their crimes have been proclaimed to the four seas and announced in the imperial edict.

sentences.zh: 羨之父子、亮及晦息，電斷之初，並即大憲。

translations.literal: Xianzhi and his son, Liang, and Hui's sons—at the very moment the lightning struck, all received the great punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhi and his son, Liang, and Hui's sons—at the very moment judgment fell, all received the supreme penalty.

sentences.zh: 復王室之讎，攄義夫之憤，國典澄明，人神感悅。

translations.literal: The royal house's wrong was avenged, righteous men's wrath was unleashed; national law was clarified, and gods and men alike were moved with joy.
translations.idiomatic: The royal house's wrong was avenged, righteous men's wrath was unleashed; national law was clarified, and gods and men alike rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 三姓同罪，既擒其二，晦之室屬，縲仆獄戶，苟幽明所怨，孤根易拔，以順討逆，雖厚必崩。

translations.literal: The three clans share the same crime; two have already been captured; Hui's household and kin are bound and fallen at prison gates—if both the hidden and manifest realms resent them, a solitary root is easily uprooted; using obedience to punish rebellion, though thick it must collapse.
translations.idiomatic: The three clans share the same crime; two have already been captured; Hui's household and kin are bound and fallen at prison gates—if both the living and the dead resent them, a solitary root is easily uprooted; using obedience to punish rebellion, though strong it must collapse.

sentences.zh: 然歸死難圖，獸困則噬，是以爰整其旅，用為過防。

translations.literal: Yet one facing death finds it hard to plot return; a cornered beast will bite—therefore he has gathered his troops as excessive defense.
translations.idiomatic: Yet a man facing death finds it hard to accept defeat; a cornered beast will bite—therefore he has gathered his troops as a desperate defense.

sentences.zh: 京師之眾，天下雲集，士練兵精，大號響震。

translations.literal: The capital's forces gather from all under Heaven like clouds; soldiers are trained, weapons sharp; the great call resounds like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: The capital's forces gather from all under Heaven like clouds; the soldiers are trained and weapons sharp; the great call resounds like thunder.

sentences.zh: 使持節、中領軍佷山縣開國侯到彥之率羽林選士果勁二萬，雲旍首路，組甲曜川。

translations.literal: Bearer of credentials, Central Palace Guard Commander, Marquis of Ken Mountain County, Dao Yanzhi leads twenty thousand selected elite guardsmen; cloud banners lead the way, linked armor gleams on the rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of credentials, Central Palace Guard Commander, Marquis of Ken Mountain County, Dao Yanzhi leads twenty thousand selected elite guardsmen; cloud banners lead the way, linked armor gleaming on the rivers.

sentences.zh: 使持節、散騎常侍、都督南徐、兗之江北淮南、青州、徐州之淮陽、下邳、琅邪、東莞七郡諸軍事、征北將軍、南兗州刺史、永修縣開國公檀道濟統勁銳武卒三萬，戈船蔽江，星言繼發，千帆俱舉，萬棹遄征。

translations.literal: Bearer of credentials, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Commander of all military affairs for the seven commanderies of southern Xu, Yan north of the river and Huainan, Qing Province, and Huaiyang, Xiapi, Langye, and Dongguan in Xu Province—Northern Campaign General, Inspector of Southern Yan Province, Duke of Yongxiu County, Tan Daoji commands thirty thousand crack troops; spear-ships cover the river; they set out at starlight in succession; a thousand sails rise together, ten thousand oars rush to war.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of credentials, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Commander of all military affairs for the seven commanderies of southern Xu, Yan north of the river and Huainan, Qing Province, and Huaiyang, Xiapi, Langye, and Dongguan in Xu Province—Northern Campaign General, Inspector of Southern Yan Province, Duke of Yongxiu County, Tan Daoji commands thirty thousand crack troops; spear-ships cover the river; they set out at starlight in succession; a thousand sails rise together, ten thousand oars rush to war.

sentences.zh: 散騎常侍、驍騎將軍段宏鐵馬二千，風驅電擊，步自竟陵，直至鄢郢。

translations.literal: Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Valiant Cavalry General Duan Hong with two thousand iron horses, driven like wind and struck like lightning, marches from Jingling straight to Yan and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Valiant Cavalry General Duan Hong with two thousand iron horses, driven like wind and struck like lightning, marches from Jingling straight to Yan and Ying.

sentences.zh: 又命征虜將軍、雍州刺史劉粹控河陰之師，衝其巢窟。

translations.literal: Also ordered Campaign General Liu Cui, Inspector of Yong Province, to control the forces at Heyin and strike their nest.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also ordered Campaign General Liu Cui, Inspector of Yong Province, to control the forces at Heyin and strike their stronghold.

sentences.zh: 湘州刺史張邵提湘川之眾，直據要害。

translations.literal: Inspector of Xiang Province Zhang Shao leads the masses of the Xiang River and directly holds the strategic points.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Xiang Province Zhang Shao leads the forces of the Xiang River and directly holds the strategic points.

sentences.zh: 巴、蜀杜荊門之險，秦、梁絕丹圻之逕，雲網四合，走伏路盡。

translations.literal: Ba and Shu block the peril of Jing Gate; Qin and Liang cut off the paths of Danji; clouds and nets close from four sides—fleeing and hiding, all roads are exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Ba and Shu block the peril of Jing Gate; Qin and Liang cut off the paths of Danji; the net closes from four sides—whether fleeing or hiding, all roads are cut off.

sentences.zh: 然後鑾輿效駕，六軍鵬翔，警蹕前驅，五牛整旆。

translations.literal: Then the imperial carriage sets out, the six armies soar like peng birds, imperial guards advance before, five oxen array their banners.
translations.idiomatic: Then the imperial carriage sets out, the six armies soar like peng birds, imperial guards advance before, and the five-ox banners are arrayed.

sentences.zh: 雖以英布之氣，彭寵之資，登陴無名，授兵誰御？

translations.literal: Even with the spirit of Ying Bu and the resources of Peng Chong, climbing the walls has no name—who would be given arms to resist?
translations.idiomatic: Even with the spirit of Ying Bu and the resources of Peng Chong, who would dare mount the walls or take up arms to resist?

sentences.zh: 加以西土之人，咸沐皇澤，東吳將士，懷本首丘，必不自陷罪人之黨，橫為亂亡之役。

translations.literal: Moreover the people of the western lands all bathe in imperial grace; the officers and soldiers of Eastern Wu yearn for home and look to their mounds—they surely will not throw themselves into the rebel's faction or serve recklessly in cause of disorder and ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the people of the western lands all bathe in imperial grace; the officers and soldiers of Eastern Wu yearn for home and look to their ancestral mounds—they surely will not throw themselves into the rebel's faction or serve recklessly in a doomed cause.

sentences.zh: 置軍則魚潰，嬰城則鳥散，其勢然矣。

translations.literal: Deploy armies and they scatter like fish in collapse; hold the walls and they disperse like birds—their situation is thus.
translations.idiomatic: Deploy armies and they scatter like fish in collapse; hold the walls and they disperse like birds—their situation is thus.

sentences.zh: 聖上殷勤哀愍，其罪由晦，士民何辜。

translations.literal: The sage sovereign is kindly compassionate—the crime lies with Hui; what guilt have soldiers and common people?
translations.idiomatic: The sage sovereign is kindly compassionate—the crime lies with Hui; what guilt have the soldiers and common people?

sentences.zh: 是用一分前麾，宣示朝旨。

translations.literal: Therefore a vanguard detachment is sent forward to proclaim the court's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore a vanguard detachment is sent forward to proclaim the court's intent.

sentences.zh: 符到，其即共收擒晦身，輕舟護送。

translations.literal: When this order arrives, immediately together capture Hui himself and escort him by light boat.
translations.idiomatic: When this order arrives, immediately capture Hui together and escort him by light boat.

sentences.zh: 若已猖蹶，先事阻衛，宜飜然背亂，相率歸朝。

translations.literal: If he has already run rampant and blocked defense beforehand, you ought to turn abruptly against rebellion and lead one another back to the court.
translations.idiomatic: If he has already run rampant and blocked your defense, you ought to turn abruptly against the rebellion and lead one another back to the court.

sentences.zh: 頃大刑所加，洪恩曠洽，傅亮三息，特蒙全宥，晦同產以下，羨之諸姪，咸無所染。

translations.literal: Recently under the great punishment applied, vast grace pervades—Fu Liang's three sons specially received full pardon; Hui's siblings and below, Xianzhi's various nephews, all were untainted.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, under the great punishment applied, vast grace pervades—Fu Liang's three sons have been specially spared; Hui's siblings and below, and Xianzhi's various nephews, were all untainted.

sentences.zh: 況彼府州文武，並列王職，荷國榮任，身雖在外，乃心辰極。

translations.literal: Moreover those civil and military officials of the prefecture and province all hold royal posts and bear the state's honored commission—though their bodies are abroad, their hearts are at the pole star.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover those civil and military officials of the prefecture and province all hold royal posts and bear the state's honored commission—though their bodies are abroad, their hearts are fixed on the capital.

sentences.zh: 夫轉禍貴速，後機則凶，遂使王師臨郊，雷電皆至，噬臍之恨，亦將何及。

translations.literal: Turning misfortune to fortune prizes speed—delay brings ruin—thus royal armies reach the suburbs, thunder and lightning arrive together; regret like biting one's navel, what use will it be then?
translations.idiomatic: Turning misfortune to fortune requires speed—delay brings ruin—thus the royal armies reach the suburbs, thunder and lightning arrive together; the regret of biting one's navel—what use will it be then?

sentences.zh: 時益州刺史蕭摹之、巴西太守劉道產被徵還，始至江陵，晦並繫縶，沒其財貨，以充軍資。

translations.literal: At this time Inspector of Yi Province Xiao Muzi and Grand Administrator of Baxi Liu Daochan were recalled—they had just reached Jiangling when Hui bound them all, confiscated their goods and wealth to fill military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Inspector of Yi Province Xiao Muzi and Grand Administrator of Baxi Liu Daochan were recalled—they had just reached Jiangling when Hui bound them all and confiscated their goods and wealth to fill his military supplies.

sentences.zh: 竟陵內史殷道鸞未之郡，以為諮議參軍。

translations.literal: Jingling Administrator Yin Daoluan had not yet reached his commandery—Hui made him Advisory Staff Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Jingling Administrator Yin Daoluan had not yet reached his commandery—Hui made him advisory staff officer.

sentences.zh: 以弟遯為冠軍、竟陵內史，總留任；

translations.literal: He made his younger brother Dun Champion General and Jingling Administrator, overseeing remaining duties;
translations.idiomatic: He made his younger brother Dun Champion General and Jingling Administrator, putting him in charge of remaining duties;

sentences.zh: 兄子世猷為建威將軍、南平太守。

translations.literal: His elder brother's son Shiyou was made Campaign General of Jianwei and Grand Administrator of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother's son Shiyou was made Campaign General of Jianwei and Grand Administrator of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 劉粹若至，周超能破之者，即以為龍驤將軍、雍州刺史。

translations.literal: If Liu Cui arrives and Zhou Chao can defeat him, Zhou Chao will be made Dragon Cavalry General and Inspector of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: If Liu Cui arrives and Zhou Chao can defeat him, Zhou Chao will be made Dragon Cavalry General and Inspector of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 晦率眾二萬，發自江陵，舟艦列自江津至於破塚，旍旂相照，蔽奪日光。

translations.literal: Hui led twenty thousand troops, setting out from Jiangling; ships lined from Jiangjin to Pozhong, banners and flags reflecting one another, blocking out the sunlight.
translations.idiomatic: Hui led twenty thousand troops from Jiangling; his ships stretched from Jiangjin to Pozhong, banners and flags reflecting one another and blocking out the sunlight.

sentences.zh: 晦乃歎曰：「恨不得以此為勤王之師！」

translations.literal: Hui then sighed and said: "I only regret that I cannot use these as troops loyal to rescue the throne!"
translations.idiomatic: Hui then sighed and said, "I only regret that I cannot use these as troops loyal to rescue the throne!"

sentences.zh: 自領湘州刺史，以張邵為輔國將軍，邵不受命。

translations.literal: He himself took the post of Inspector of Xiang Province and appointed Zhang Shao Assistant State General—Shao did not accept the commission.
translations.idiomatic: He himself took the post of Inspector of Xiang Province and appointed Zhang Shao Assistant State General—Shao did not accept the commission.

sentences.zh: 晦檄京邑曰：

translations.literal: Hui issued a proclamation to the capital stating:
translations.idiomatic: Hui issued a proclamation to the capital stating:

sentences.zh: 王室多故，禍難薦臻。

translations.literal: The royal house has many troubles; calamities repeatedly arrive.
translations.idiomatic: The royal house has suffered many troubles; calamities have repeatedly arrived.

sentences.zh: 營陽失德，自絕宗廟。

translations.literal: Yingyang lost virtue and severed himself from the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yingyang lost virtue and severed himself from the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 廬陵王構鬩有本，屢被猜嫌，且居喪失禮，遐邇所具，積怨犯上，自貽非道。

translations.literal: The Prince of Luling had cause for discord, was repeatedly suspected, moreover violated mourning propriety—as known far and near—accumulated resentment, offended superiors, and brought upon himself unjust death.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Luling had cause for discord and was repeatedly suspected; moreover he violated mourning propriety, as was known far and near—he accumulated resentment, offended his superiors, and brought unjust death upon himself.

sentences.zh: 群后釋位，爰登聖明，亂之未乂，職有所系。

translations.literal: The ministers relinquished their posts, then ascended the sage and bright one; disorder was not yet settled, duties had ties.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers relinquished their posts and enthroned the sage and bright sovereign; disorder was not yet settled, and duties remained bound.

sentences.zh: 按車騎大將軍王弘、侍中王曇首，謬蒙時私，叨竊權要。

translations.literal: Investigating General of Chariots and Cavalry Wang Hong and Palace Attendant Wang Tanshou—they wrongly received private favor of the times and greedily seized crucial power.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating General of Chariots and Cavalry Wang Hong and Palace Attendant Wang Tanshou—they wrongly received private favor and greedily seized crucial power.

sentences.zh: 弘於永初之始，實荷不世之恩，元嘉之讓，自謂任遇浮淺，進誣先皇委誠之寄，退長嫌隙異同之端。

translations.literal: Hong at the start of Yongchu in truth bore unmatched grace; in Yuanjia's abdication he felt his appointment shallow—in advance he falsely charged the late emperor's trust in good faith; in retreat he fostered suspicion and seeds of division.
translations.idiomatic: Hong at the start of Yongchu in truth bore unmatched grace; in Yuanjia's succession he felt his appointment shallow—in advance he falsely charged the late emperor's trust in good faith; in retreat he fostered suspicion and seeds of division.

sentences.zh: 曇首往因使下，訪以今上起居，不能光揚令德，彰於朝聽，其言多誣，故不具說。

translations.literal: Tanshou formerly, when envoys came down, inquired after the present emperor's daily conduct and could not spread his fine virtue to the court's hearing—his words were mostly false, so details are not given.
translations.idiomatic: Tanshou formerly, when envoys came down, inquired after the present emperor's daily conduct and could not spread his fine virtue to the court's hearing—his words were mostly false, so details are not given.

sentences.zh: 王華賊亡之餘，賞擢之次，先帝常見訪逮，庶有一分可取，而華稟性凶猜，多所忍害。

translations.literal: Wang Hua was among the surviving remnants of rebels, promoted in turn—the late emperor often sought and questioned him, hoping there might be something to commend, yet Hua's nature was fierce and suspicious, and he harmed many.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hua was among the surviving remnants of rebels, promoted in turn—the late emperor often sought and questioned him, hoping there might be something to commend, yet Hua's nature was fierce and suspicious, and he harmed many.

sentences.zh: 曩者縱人入城，託疾辭事，此都士庶，咸所聞知。

translations.literal: Formerly he allowed someone to enter the city and feigned illness to resign office—this capital's gentlemen and commoners all heard and knew.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly he allowed someone to enter the city and feigned illness to resign office—the gentlemen and commoners of this capital all heard and knew.

sentences.zh: 以其所啟及上手答示宗叔獻，又令宣告徐、傅二公。

translations.literal: With his memorial and the emperor's written reply he showed Zong Shuxian, and also had them proclaimed to the two lords Xu and Fu.
translations.idiomatic: With his memorial and the emperor's written reply he showed Zong Shuxian, and also had them proclaimed to Lords Xu and Fu.

sentences.zh: 及周糾使下，又令見咨，云：「欲自攬政事，求離任還都，並令曇首具述此意。」

translations.literal: When Zhou's envoy came down to investigate, he again had him consulted, saying: "I wish to take government affairs into my own hands, seek to leave my post and return to the capital," and had Tanshou fully relate this intent."
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou's envoy came down to investigate, he again had him consulted, saying, "I wish to take government affairs into my own hands and seek to leave my post and return to the capital," and had Tanshou fully relate this intent.

sentences.zh: 又惠觀道人說，外人告華及到彥之謀反，不謂無之。

translations.literal: Also according to what the Daoist priest Huiguan said, outsiders reported that Hua and Dao Yanzhi plotted rebellion—it is not to say this was entirely without basis.
translations.idiomatic: Also according to what the Daoist priest Huiguan said, outsiders reported that Hua and Dao Yanzhi plotted rebellion—it is not to say this was entirely without basis.

sentences.zh: 城內東將，數日之內，操戈相待。

translations.literal: Eastern generals within the city, within days, held weapons ready against one another.
translations.idiomatic: Within the city, eastern generals held weapons ready against one another within days.

sentences.zh: 華說數為秋當所譖，常不自安。

translations.literal: Hua said he was repeatedly slandered by Qiudang and was often ill at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Hua said he was repeatedly slandered by Qiudang and was often ill at ease.

sentences.zh: 凡此諸事，豈有忠誠冥契若此者邪？

translations.literal: All these matters—can there be loyal sincerity and secret accord such as this?
translations.idiomatic: All these matters—can there be loyal sincerity and secret accord such as this?

sentences.zh: 自以父亡道側，情事異人，外絕酒醴，而宵飲是恣。

translations.literal: Taking himself as one whose father died by the roadside, his circumstances different from others—outwardly he abstained from wine, yet at night he indulged freely.
translations.idiomatic: Taking himself as one whose father died by the roadside, his circumstances different from others—outwardly he abstained from wine, yet at night he indulged freely.

sentences.zh: 靦貌囗囗囗囗囗囗凡厥士庶，誰不側目。

translations.literal: With shameless countenance [damaged text in source] among all gentlemen and commoners, who would not look askance?
translations.idiomatic: With shameless countenance [damaged text in source]—among all gentlemen and commoners, who would not look askance?

sentences.zh: 又常歎宰相頓有數人，是何憤憤，規總威權，不顧國典。

translations.literal: Also he often lamented that there were suddenly several chancellors—what muddle is this—scheming to monopolize authority, heedless of national law.
translations.idiomatic: Also he often lamented that there were suddenly several chancellors—what muddle is this—scheming to monopolize authority, heedless of national law.

sentences.zh: 保祐皇家者，罹屠戮之誅；

translations.literal: Those who protected the royal house suffered slaughter's punishment;
translations.idiomatic: Those who protected the royal house suffered slaughter's punishment;

sentences.zh: 效勤社稷者，致殲夷之禍。

translations.literal: Those who served zealously for the altars of soil and grain met extermination's calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Those who served zealously for the altars of soil and grain met extermination's calamity.

sentences.zh: 搢紳之徒，孰不忼慨！

translations.literal: Among the gentry and officials, who was not indignant!
translations.idiomatic: Among the gentry and officials, who was not indignant!

sentences.zh: 遂矯違詔旨，遣到彥之、蕭欣之輕舟見襲。

translations.literal: Then they forged and violated the edict's intent, sending Dao Yanzhi and Xiao Xin in light boats to attack suddenly.
translations.idiomatic: Then they forged and violated the edict's intent, sending Dao Yanzhi and Xiao Xin in light boats to attack suddenly.

sentences.zh: 即日監利左尉露檄眾軍已至揚子。

translations.literal: That very day the Left Warden of Jianli posted an open proclamation: the armies have reached Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: That very day the Left Warden of Jianli posted an open proclamation that the armies had reached Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 雖以不武，忝荷蕃任，國家艱難，悲憤兼集。

translations.literal: Though lacking in martial prowess, I shamefully bear frontier duty—national crisis, grief and rage combined.
translations.idiomatic: Though lacking in martial prowess, I shamefully bear frontier duty—the nation is in crisis, and grief and rage combine within me.

sentences.zh: 若使小人得志，君子道消，凡百有殄瘁之哀，蒼生深橫流之懼。

translations.literal: If petty men gain their will and the way of gentlemen vanishes—all will have the sorrow of wasting away, the common people deep fear of being swept away.
translations.idiomatic: If petty men gain their will and the way of gentlemen vanishes—all will have the sorrow of wasting away, and the common people will deeply fear being swept away.

sentences.zh: 輒糾勒義徒，繕治舟甲，舳艫亙川，駟介蔽野，武夫鷙勇，人百其誠。

translations.literal: I have gathered righteous followers and prepared ships and armor; boats span the river, war-chariots cover the plain; fierce warriors each show a hundredfold loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: I have gathered righteous followers and prepared ships and armor; boats span the river, war-chariots cover the plain; fierce warriors each show a hundredfold loyalty.

sentences.zh: 今遣南蠻司馬、寧遠將軍庾登之統參軍事、建武將軍建平太守安泰、宣威將軍昭弘宗、參軍事宣威將軍王紹之等，精銳一萬，前鋒致討。

translations.literal: Now I dispatch Southern Man Marshal, General of Ningyuan Yu Dengzhi to command Staff Officer, Campaign General of Jianwu and Grand Administrator of Jianping An Tai, General of Xuanwei Zhao Hongzong, Staff Officer and General of Xuanwei Wang Shaozhi, and others—ten thousand elite troops as vanguard to strike.
translations.idiomatic: Now I dispatch Southern Man Marshal, General of Ningyuan Yu Dengzhi to command Staff Officer, Campaign General of Jianwu and Grand Administrator of Jianping An Tai, General of Xuanwei Zhao Hongzong, Staff Officer and General of Xuanwei Wang Shaozhi, and others—ten thousand elite troops as vanguard to strike.

sentences.zh: 南蠻參軍、振武將軍魏像統參軍事、宣威將軍陳珍虎旅二千，參軍事、建威將軍、新興太守賀愔甲卒三千，相係取道。

translations.literal: Southern Man Staff Officer, General of Zhenwu Wei Xiang commands Staff Officer and General of Xuanwei Chen Zhen with two thousand tiger troops; Staff Officer, Campaign General of Jianwei and Grand Administrator of Xinxing He Yin with three thousand armored soldiers—they advance by linked routes.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Man Staff Officer, General of Zhenwu Wei Xiang commands Staff Officer and General of Xuanwei Chen Zhen with two thousand tiger troops; Staff Officer, Campaign General of Jianwei and Grand Administrator of Xinxing He Yin with three thousand armored soldiers—they advance by linked routes.

sentences.zh: 南蠻參軍、振威將軍郭卓鐵騎二千，水步齊舉。

translations.literal: Southern Man Staff Officer, General of Zhenwei Guo Zhuo with two thousand iron cavalry—water and land forces advance together.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Man Staff Officer, General of Zhenwei Guo Zhuo with two thousand iron cavalry—water and land forces advance together.

sentences.zh: 大軍三萬，駱驛電邁。

translations.literal: The great army of thirty thousand, galloping like relay horses, rushing like lightning.
translations.idiomatic: The great army of thirty thousand gallops like relay horses and rushes like lightning.

sentences.zh: 行冠軍將軍、竟陵內史、河東太守謝遯、建威將軍、南平太守謝世猷驍勇一萬，留守江陵。

translations.literal: Acting Champion General, Jingling Administrator, Hedong Grand Administrator Xie Dun and Campaign General of Jianwei, Nanping Grand Administrator Xie Shiyou lead ten thousand valiant troops to guard Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Champion General, Jingling Administrator, and Hedong Grand Administrator Xie Dun and Campaign General of Jianwei and Nanping Grand Administrator Xie Shiyou lead ten thousand valiant troops to guard Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 分命參軍、長寧太守竇應期步騎五千，直出義陽。

translations.literal: Separately ordered Staff Officer, Changning Grand Administrator Dou Yingqi with five thousand infantry and cavalry to march straight out from Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: He separately ordered Staff Officer and Changning Grand Administrator Dou Yingqi with five thousand infantry and cavalry to march straight out from Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 司馬、建威將軍、行南義陽太守周超之統軍司馬、振武將軍胡崇之精悍一萬，北出高陽，長兼行參軍、寧遠將軍朱澹之步騎五千，西出雁塞，同討劉粹，並趨襄陽。

translations.literal: Marshal, Campaign General of Jianwei, Acting Grand Administrator of Southern Yiyang Zhou Chao commands Army Marshal, General of Zhenwu Hu Chong with ten thousand crack troops, marching north out of Gaoyang; Senior Acting Staff Officer, General of Ningyuan Zhu Tanzhi with five thousand infantry and cavalry, marching west out of Yan Pass—they jointly attack Liu Cui and all converge on Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal, Campaign General of Jianwei, and Acting Grand Administrator of Southern Yiyang Zhou Chao commands Army Marshal and General of Zhenwu Hu Chong with ten thousand crack troops, marching north out of Gaoyang; Senior Acting Staff Officer and General of Ningyuan Zhu Tanzhi with five thousand infantry and cavalry, marching west out of Yan Pass—they jointly attack Liu Cui and all converge on Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 奇兵尚速，指景齊奮。

translations.literal: Unconventional troops prize speed—point at the sun, advance together.
translations.idiomatic: Unconventional troops prize speed—point at the sun and advance together.

sentences.zh: 諸賢並同國恩，情兼義烈，今誠志士忘身之日，義夫著績之秋，見機而動，望風而不待勖。

translations.literal: All worthies share the state's grace, feeling and righteous fervor combined—now is truly the day for men of resolve to forget themselves, the season for men of duty to establish merit; see opportunity and act, look to the wind and need no urging.
translations.idiomatic: All worthies share the state's grace, feeling and righteous fervor combined—now is truly the day for men of resolve to forget themselves, the season for men of duty to establish merit; see opportunity and act, look to the wind and need no urging.

sentences.zh: 晦至江口，到彥之已到彭城洲。

translations.literal: Hui reached the river mouth; Dao Yanzhi had already reached Pengcheng Isle.
translations.idiomatic: Hui reached the river mouth; Dao Yanzhi had already reached Pengcheng Isle.

sentences.zh: 庾登之據巴陵，畏懦不敢進。

translations.literal: Yu Dengzhi held Baling but was timid and fearful, not daring to advance.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Dengzhi held Baling but was timid and fearful, not daring to advance.

sentences.zh: 會霖雨連日，參軍劉和之曰：「彼此共有雨耳，檀征北尋至，東軍方強，唯宜速戰。」

translations.literal: As continuous heavy rain fell for days, Staff Officer Liu Hezhi said: "Both sides have rain alike—Northern Campaign General Tan will soon arrive and the eastern army is just growing strong; we should only fight quickly."
translations.idiomatic: As continuous heavy rain fell for days, Staff Officer Liu Hezhi said, "Both sides have rain alike—Northern Campaign General Tan will soon arrive and the eastern army is just growing strong; we should only fight quickly."

sentences.zh: 登之恇怯，使小將陳祐作大囊，貯茅數千斛，縣於颿檣，云可以焚艦，用火宜須晴，以緩戰期。

translations.literal: Dengzhi was cowardly; he had junior officer Chen You make large sacks storing several thousand piculs of thatch, hung from sail masts, saying they could burn enemy ships—that fire required clear weather—to delay the battle schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Dengzhi was cowardly; he had junior officer Chen You make large sacks storing several thousand piculs of thatch, hung from sail masts, saying they could burn enemy ships—that fire required clear weather—to delay the battle schedule.

sentences.zh: 晦然之，遂停軍十五日。

translations.literal: Hui approved this and halted the army for fifteen days.
translations.idiomatic: Hui approved this and halted the army for fifteen days.

sentences.zh: 乃攻蕭欣於彭城洲，中兵參軍孔延秀率三千人進戰，甚力。

translations.literal: Then he attacked Xiao Xin at Pengcheng Isle; Central Army Staff Officer Kong Yanxiu led three thousand men into battle with great force.
translations.idiomatic: Then he attacked Xiao Xin at Pengcheng Isle; Central Army Staff Officer Kong Yanxiu led three thousand men into battle with great force.

sentences.zh: 欣於陳後擁楯自衛，又委軍還船，於是大敗。

translations.literal: Xin behind the formation shielded himself with large shields, then abandoned the army and returned to the ships—in consequence a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Xin shielded himself with large shields behind the formation, then abandoned the army and returned to the ships—in consequence a great defeat.

sentences.zh: 延秀又攻洲口柵，陷之，彥之退保隱圻。

translations.literal: Yanxiu again attacked the stockade at the isle mouth, captured it; Yanzhi retreated to defend Yinqi.
translations.idiomatic: Yanxiu again attacked the stockade at the isle mouth and captured it; Yanzhi retreated to defend Yinqi.

sentences.zh: 晦又上表曰：

translations.literal: Hui again submitted a memorial stating:
translations.idiomatic: Hui again submitted a memorial stating:

sentences.zh: 臣聞凶邪敗國，先代成患；

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that evil and depravity ruin states—former ages made this a chronic ill;
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has heard that evil and depravity ruin states—former ages made this a chronic ill;

sentences.zh: 讒豎亂朝，異世齊禍。

translations.literal: Slanderers rise and disorder the court—in different eras the calamity is the same.
translations.idiomatic: Slanderers rise and disorder the court—in different eras the calamity is the same.

sentences.zh: 故趙高矯逼，秦氏用傾；

translations.literal: Thus Zhao Gao forged commands and coerced—the Qin house was overturned;
translations.idiomatic: Thus Zhao Gao forged commands and coerced—the Qin house was overturned;

sentences.zh: 董卓階亂，漢祚伊覆。

translations.literal: Dong Zhuo ascended through chaos—the Han fortune was overthrown.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Zhuo ascended through chaos—the Han fortune was overthrown.

sentences.zh: 雖哲王宰世，大明照臨，未能使其漸弗興，茲害不作。

translations.literal: Though sage kings govern the age and great brightness shines down, they could not keep such evils from gradually arising or this harm from occurring.
translations.idiomatic: Though sage kings govern the age and great brightness shines down, they could not keep such evils from gradually arising or this harm from occurring.

sentences.zh: 奸臣王弘等竊弄威權，興造禍亂，遂與弟華內外影響，同惡相成，忌害忠賢，圖希非望。

translations.literal: Treacherous ministers Wang Hong and others secretly wielded authority and stirred up calamity and disorder, then with his brother Hua coordinated inside and out, like shadows answering each other, alike in evil mutually completing—envying and harming loyal worthies, scheming for illegitimate ambitions.
translations.idiomatic: Treacherous ministers Wang Hong and others secretly wielded authority and stirred up calamity and disorder, then with his brother Hua coordinated inside and out, like shadows answering each other, alike in evil mutually completing—envying and harming loyal worthies, scheming for illegitimate ambitions.

sentences.zh: 故司徒臣羨之、左光祿大夫臣亮橫被酷害，並及臣門。

translations.literal: Thus Minister of Works your servant Xianzhi and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness your servant Liang were cruelly harmed across the board, extending to my household.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Minister of Works your servant Xianzhi and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness your servant Liang were cruelly harmed across the board, extending to my household.

sentences.zh: 雖未知征北將軍臣道濟存亡，不容獨免。

translations.literal: Though it is not yet known whether Northern Campaign General your servant Daoji lives or dies, he cannot alone be spared.
translations.idiomatic: Though it is not yet known whether Northern Campaign General your servant Daoji lives or dies, he cannot alone be spared.

sentences.zh: 遂遣蕭欣、到彥之等輕舟見襲，奸偽之甚，一至於斯。

translations.literal: Then they sent Xiao Xin, Dao Yanzhi, and others in light boats to attack suddenly—the treachery and fraud reached such an extreme.
translations.idiomatic: Then they sent Xiao Xin, Dao Yanzhi, and others in light boats to attack suddenly—the treachery and fraud reached such an extreme.

sentences.zh: 羨之及亮，或宿德元臣，姻婭皇極，或任總文武，位班三事，道濟職惟上將，捍城是司，皆受遇先朝，棟樑一代。

translations.literal: Xianzhi and Liang—some were elder worthies of longstanding virtue, connected by marriage to the imperial pole; others held general charge of civil and military affairs, ranked among the Three Dignities; Daoji's office was foremost general, guardian of the ramparts—all received favor from the former court, pillars of a generation.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhi and Liang—some were elder worthies of longstanding virtue, connected by marriage to the imperial throne; others held general charge of civil and military affairs and ranked among the Three Dignities; Daoji's office was foremost general and guardian of the ramparts—all received favor from the former court and were pillars of a generation.

sentences.zh: 臣昔因時幸，過蒙先眷，內聞政事，外經戎旅，與羨之、亮等同被齒盼。

translations.literal: In former days your servant, through the fortune of the times, excessively received prior favor—within he heard state affairs, without he passed through military campaigns, and together with Xianzhi and Liang received equal rank and regard.
translations.idiomatic: In former days your servant, through the fortune of the times, received beyond measure the late emperor's favor—I heard affairs of state from within and led armies without, and together with Xianzhi and Liang was granted equal rank and regard.

sentences.zh: 既經啟王基，協濟大業，爰自權輿，暨於揖讓，誠策雖微，仍見紀錄，竝蒙丹書之誓，各受山河之賞，欲使與宋升降，傳之無窮。

translations.literal: Having already helped lay the royal foundation and jointly aided the great enterprise, from the very cart-shafts through abdication, though our sincere counsels were slight they were still recorded; all received oaths in red ink and each received rewards like mountains and rivers—the intent being that we should rise and fall with Song and pass this down without end.
translations.idiomatic: Having helped lay the royal foundation and jointly served the great enterprise—from the dynasty's first beginnings through abdication—though our counsels were modest they were recorded; we all received oaths inscribed in red ink and rewards vast as mountains and rivers, intended that we should rise and fall with Song and pass this down forever.

sentences.zh: 及聖體不預，穆卜無吉，召臣等四人，同升御床，顧命領遺，委以家國。
